skills.description: AI-powered transpiration rate estimation for indoor plants. From smart planters or fixed cameras, uses thermal infrared images of leaves (preferred) — or regular RGB images combined with ambient temperature/humidity — to estimate the leaf-to-air temperature difference, combines radiation/humidity parameters (sensor or model-inferred), and computes a relative transpiration rate index (0-100%).
